Subject: loop quantum gravity | ID: 3489

Step 3. By the diagonalizable spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01320013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the diagonalizable spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through real approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
